description.zh-HK: 前中區警署建築群，經保育活化後開放，可參觀監獄操場、法院及歷史展覽，建築風格獨特。
description.zh-CN: 前中区警署建筑群，经保育活化后开放，可参观监狱操场、法院及历史展览，建筑风格独特。
description.en: The former Central Police Station compound, revitalized and opened to the public. Visitors can explore the prison yard, courtrooms, and historical exhibitions, with unique architectural styles.

description.zh-HK: 位於荷李活道，是香港最古老的廟宇之一，塔香繚繞，極具傳統氛圍。
description.zh-CN: 位于荷李活道，是香港最古老的庙宇之一，塔香缭绕，极具传统氛围。
description.en: Located on Hollywood Road, Man Mo Temple is one of Hong Kong's oldest temples, filled with incense coils and a strong traditional atmosphere.

description.zh-HK: 位於中環半山，介紹孫中山先生的生平及與香港的關係，建築本身為法定古蹟。
description.zh-CN: 位于中环半山，介绍孙中山先生的生平及与香港的关系，建筑本身为法定古迹。
description.en: Located in Mid-Levels Central, the museum showcases the life of Dr Sun Yat-sen and his connection with Hong Kong. The building itself is a declared monument.

description.zh-HK: 由傳奇的九龍寨城改建而成的江南園林，保留了衙門建築和部分遺跡，歷史感濃厚。
description.zh-CN: 由传奇的九龙寨城改建而成的江南园林，保留了衙门建筑和部分遗迹，历史感浓厚。
description.en: Transformed from the legendary Kowloon Walled City, this Jiangnan-style garden preserves the yamen building and remnants of the past, rich in historical atmosphere.

description.zh-HK: 位於鑽石山，仿唐代園林設計，環境恬靜，有金閣寺風格的圓滿閣，是鬧市中的淨土。
description.zh-CN: 位于钻石山，仿唐代园林设计，环境恬静，有金阁寺风格的圆满阁，是闹市中的净土。
description.en: Located in Diamond Hill, Nan Lian Garden is designed in the Tang dynasty style. With its serene environment and the Pavilion of Absolute Perfection, it is a peaceful oasis in the city.

description.zh-HK: 與南蓮園池相連，是大型仿唐木構建築群，氣勢宏偉，全木結構無釘設計。
description.zh-CN: 与南莲园池相连，是大型仿唐木构建筑群，气势宏伟，全木结构无钉设计。
description.en: Connected to Nan Lian Garden, Chi Lin Nunnery is a grand Tang-style wooden architectural complex, built entirely without nails.
